exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Solana (SOL) traded at $73.3500 as of 2026-11-17 12:36:58 UTC, +1.85% over one hour and +3.72% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $69.9600 to $73.4400; spot sits at 97% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -13.06% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($71.8732) is above the 72-hour average ($71.6970). Spot is 13.99% below the seven-day high of $85.2803 and 8.10% above the seven-day low of $67.8563.

exhibits.title: Volatility & Momentum
exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 4.25% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 63.2, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.title: Liquidity
exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $2.93 billion, equal to 6.74% of the $43.41 billion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 12 ("Extreme Fear"), versus 32 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink SOL/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $72.0300, 14.5 hours before the spot quote and -1.80% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. SOL is currently trading near the top of its 24‑hour range, at 97% of the $69.96‑$73.44 band, demonstrating upward pressure that historically precedes short‑term continuations [Ex. B, A].  

2. Momentum remains intact: realized volatility is modest at 4.25% per day and the 14‑hour RSI sits in neutral‑to‑bullish territory at 63.2, indicating the price can sustain its 1.85% one‑hour gain without immediate reversal [Ex. D, A].  

3. Market sentiment has shifted dramatically to “Extreme Fear” (CFGI 12, down from 32 a week ago), a classic contrarian signal that historically fuels buying pressure, while liquidity is ample at $2.93 B, ensuring execution of a long position without slippage [Ex. F, E].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.

1. The spot price of SOL is markedly above the Chainlink reference price, trading at $73.35 versus the $72.03 feed – a 1.80% premium that creates immediate upside for a short‑term buyer and demonstrates a mispricing that will correct toward the oracle price within the 24‑hour horizon [Ex. A, G].

2. Momentum is turning bullish: the 24‑hour average ($71.8732) now exceeds the 72‑hour average ($71.6970), and the RSI at 63.2, while neutral, sits well above the 50‑point midpoint, indicating buying pressure that is likely to push price toward the upper range of its 24‑hour band [$71.8732 vs $71.6970, $69.96‑$73.44] [Ex. B, C, D].

3. Market sentiment is in “Extreme Fear” (index 12), a classic contrarian signal that precedes rapid price recoveries, and the $2.93 B of daily volume provides ample depth for a short practice position to be entered and settled without slippage [Ex. E, F].

The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s first claim hinges on a presumed “mispricing” between spot and the Chainlink feed, yet Exhibit G itself shows the feed is 14.5 hours stale; price convergence within a 24‑hour window is not guaranteed, especially when spot has already risen 1.85 % in the last hour, suggesting the premium may persist rather than erode.  

Second, the Bear touts bullish momentum, but Exhibit D lists the RSI at 63.2—still in neutral territory—and realized volatility at 4.25 % per day, indicating modest price swings insufficient to drive SOL to the upper band before settlement. Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s first point collapses under Exhibit B: the price sits at 97 % of the 24‑hour range, but the range’s upper bound is $73.44, only $0.09 above today’s spot, leaving essentially no upward runway and suggesting a ceiling rather than continuation. The Bull’s second point misreads Exhibit D: a 4.25 % daily volatility is modest, yet the RSI of 63.2 is merely neutral, not bullish, and historically a neutral RSI precedes pull‑backs when price nears range tops. Thus the cited momentum cannot justify a long. Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds the evidence balanced and declines to open a practice position.

findings.finding: Spot price $73.35 is 1.85% up hour‑over‑hour and 3.72% up day‑over‑day, showing recent strength
Price sits at 97% of its 24‑hour range, only $0.09 below the high, indicating limited upside
Fear & Greed Index at 12 (Extreme Fear) after a week‑earlier 32, a contrarian bullish signal
Chainlink feed lags 14.5 h and is $1.80 lower than spot, creating a potential correction risk

ruling.opinion: The Court notes recent price gains and extreme‑fear sentiment support a bullish view, yet the price is essentially at the top of a tight 24‑hour band and the stale oracle suggests a possible pull‑back toward the feed level. The mixed signals prevent a confident direction for the next 24 hours, so no practice position is warranted.
ruling.dissent: Bull counsel argues that the extreme‑fear contrarian signal and modest volatility outweigh the near‑range ceiling, implying continued upside.

sentence.reason: The case was dismissed; no practice position is ordered.
